# AI Engineer (LLM Platform)

Location: Berlin, Germany

Hybrid: 2 days per week in our Berlin office.

## About Flintwave

Flintwave (a fictional company) builds analytics tools for logistics teams. We are 60 people and growing.

## What you'll do

- Build LLM-powered features that help customers query their shipment data
- Own the evaluation pipeline for our retrieval and generation quality
- Work closely with product and design

## What you bring

- 4+ years of professional experience with Python
- Experience building RAG systems with vector databases
- Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL
- Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
- 3+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production
- Fluent English

## Nice to have

- Experience with LangGraph or similar agent frameworks
- Familiarity with Terraform
- German language skills
- Experience with Rust

## What we offer

- 30 vacation days
- Learning budget

We cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role.
